title: FlexEE: Self-Speculative and KV-Compatible Early Exiting for Offloading-Aware LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2609.17008v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference is often constrained by both computation and memory, especially in offloading-based deployments where model weights are transferred across memory hierarchies during autoregressive decoding. In this setting, reducing the number of executed layers can lower per-token latency while also avoiding costly weight movement. Motivated by this observation, we present FlexEE, an early exiting framework for resource-constrained and offloading-based LLM inference. FlexEE makes early exiting practical for LLM decoding through layer-wise exit supervision for reliable intermediate-layer prediction, self-speculative decoding over a Top-K local vocabulary for low-cost exit decisions, and dynamic hidden state management for KV-cache-correct and memory-aware execution. Across generative and downstream tasks, FlexEE enables efficient early exit with minimal accuracy degradation, delivering up to 1.27$\times$/3.16$\times$

translated_title: FlexEE：面向卸载感知LLM推理的自推测与KV兼容早退框架
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）推理通常受到计算和内存的双重约束，尤其是在基于卸载（offloading）的部署场景中，自回归解码期间模型权重需要在内存层次结构之间来回传输。在这种设置下，减少实际执行的层数不仅可以降低每个token的生成延迟，还能避免昂贵的权重传输开销。基于这一观察，我们提出了FlexEE，一个面向资源受限和基于卸载的LLM推理的早退（early exiting）框架。FlexEE通过以下三项技术使早退在LLM解码中变得切实可行：逐层退出监督，以实现可靠的中间层预测；基于Top-K局部词表的自推测解码，以实现低成本的退出决策；以及动态隐藏状态管理，以确保KV缓存的正确性和内存感知的执行。在生成式任务和下游任务中，FlexEE均能实现高效的早退且精度损失极小，可提供高达1.27×/3.16×的性能提升。
tldr: FlexEE是一个面向资源受限和卸载式LLM推理的早退框架，通过逐层退出监督、基于Top-K局部词表的自推测解码和动态隐藏状态管理三项技术，在保证KV缓存正确性的前提下实现高效早退，最高可带来3.16倍的性能提升且精度损失极小。
en_tdlr: FlexEE is an early exiting framework for resource-constrained and offloading-based LLM inference that achieves efficient early exit through layer-wise exit supervision, self-speculative decoding over a Top-K local vocabulary, and dynamic hidden state management, delivering up to 3.16× speedup with minimal accuracy degradation.
